name: WazChat – Chat button widget
author: awsm.in

sections.description:
WazChat is a simple yet powerful WordPress plugin that enables direct WhatsApp communication between your website visitors and your team. Whether you’re running a business website, an online store, or a personal blog, WazChat helps you connect with your audience instantly.

Key Features

  • One-Click WhatsApp Connection – Let visitors start WhatsApp chats with your team instantly
  • Customizable Chat Widget – Match your website’s style with custom colors and positioning
  • Team Management – Add multiple team members with different availability schedules
  • Smart Routing – Direct customers to the right team member based on their department or availability
  • Pre-defined Messages – Create templates for common questions to save time
  • Responsive Design – Works perfectly on all devices (mobile, tablet, desktop)

Who is WazChat For?

  • Online Stores – Provide instant shopping assistance
  • Service Businesses – Answer questions and book appointments
  • Agencies – Connect clients with the right team member
  • Bloggers & Content Creators – Build a closer relationship with your audience
  • Anyone – Who wants to offer quick, personalized support

Source Code

The unminified source code for JavaScript and CSS is included in the /src directory.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/waz-chat directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to ‘WazChat’ in your WordPress admin menu to configure settings
  4. Add your WhatsApp number and customize the appearance
  5. Save changes and your WhatsApp chat widget will appear on your website
sections.faq:
Does this require a WhatsApp Business account?

No, WazChat works with regular WhatsApp accounts as well as WhatsApp Business accounts.

Can I add multiple team members?

Yes, you can add multiple team members with different WhatsApp numbers and set availability hours for each.

Can I customize the appearance of the chat widget?

Yes, you can customize colors, position, and text to match your website’s design.

Will this work on mobile devices?

Yes, WazChat is fully responsive and works seamlessly on mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

Does this integrate with WooCommerce?

Yes, WazChat works great with WooCommerce and can help provide instant support for your online store customers.

Is this GDPR compliant?

Yes, WazChat is designed with privacy in mind. We provide necessary tools to ensure GDPR compliance, including customizable privacy policy links and data management options.
